title: Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst – CitiKYC MIS Cognos Reporting
description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced MIS Reporting Developer / Senior Programmer Analyst to join our CitiKYC Reporting Technology team. The ideal candidate will serve as a lead reporting specialist with extensive, proven expertise in developing and managing global enterprise-level reports, semantic models, and distribution frameworks using IBM Cognos Analytics as the primary business intelligence toolset, complemented by strong visualization and dashboarding capabilities. The candidate must have strong hands-on proficiency in querying, optimizing, and analyzing large datasets primarily hosted on Oracle databases, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and strict adherence to regulatory reporting reliability standards. Job Background / Context Know Your Customer (KYC) is an enterprise due diligence process executed when accepting, or periodically renewing, business relationships. This process ensures compliance with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Customer Identification Program Procedures (CIP-P), and other regulatory mandates designed to protect Citi from financial crime risks. CitiKYC is a unified global platform across Citi's business lines. Its core objective is to reduce KYC complexity through process standardization, automated workflows, and robust regulatory MIS reporting. This team is directly responsible for delivering reporting solutions that monitor KYC record throughput, backlog, SLA management, and compliance risk indicators for senior management and regulatory bodies. Key Responsibilities Cognos Enterprise Reporting (Primary): Lead the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of operational, regulatory, and management reports using the full IBM Cognos Analytics suite (Report Studio, Query Studio, Dashboard, Event Studio, and Framework Manager / Data Modules). Oracle Data Layer & Query Optimization (Primary DB): Write, fine-tune, and optimize complex Oracle SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks, views, and stored procedures to extract, aggregate, and transform high-volume datasets efficiently. BI Administration & Security: Implement best practices for enterprise BI administration, metadata modeling, role-based access control, object-level security, and scheduled report distribution across Cognos environments. Requirements & Strategy: Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, KYC Operations leads, Compliance Officers, and Data Architects to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable reporting solutions. Maintenance & Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot report failures, resolve data discrepancies, and optimize report execution times and database access paths for peak operational efficiency. Mentorship & Support: Provide technical guidance, code/model reviews, and mentorship to junior developers; deliver training and tier-3 support to end-users on reporting tools. Knowledge & Experience Essential 6+ years of professional experience in enterprise reporting and BI development, with IBM Cognos Analytics (including Cognos 10.x/11.x) as the primary tool. Advanced Cognos Expertise: Deep proficiency in Framework Manager metadata modeling (relational and dimensional), complex multi-page and master-detail report authoring, drill-through definitions, event-driven scheduling, and Cognos security models. Primary Database (Oracle): Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL / PL/SQL , query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies, and relational database / data warehousing architectures. SDLC: Solid experience working through full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) phases under both Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to articulate technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable / Good to Have Starburst / Presto: Experience with Starburst Presto for federated query execution, data integration, and access governance. NoSQL / Alternate Data Sources: Exposure to MongoDB or big data repositories. Domain Knowledge: Functional understanding of AML / KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and regulatory compliance metrics. Report Migration: Prior experience converting legacy reports or migrating reports between platforms Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with workload automation and scheduling tools (Autosys, Cron), Unix/Linux shell scripting, or Cognos Java SDK. Qualifications & Certifications Essential Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related quantitative discipline. title: Application support Analyst
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview TUCI Production Support is a 24x7 support and engineering function under TransUnion’s DevOps organization supporting business, products and customers of TransUnion Consumer Interactive (TUCI). We are focused on maintaining application reliability, stability, and performance of the mission-critical platforms across multiple geographies, ensuring business continuity through robust support practices and operational excellence. We operate under a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) framework, blending technical depth with operational rigor. Our team serves as the connective layer between development, infrastructure, and business units—delivering seamless application experiences to our customers worldwide.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. Role Overview And Core Responsibilities We are looking for a skilled Application Support Analyst to join our 24x7 production support team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in supporting applications hosted on cloud platforms and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), with deep expertise in Linux, SQL, and automation. The role involves incident management, batch job execution, shell scripting, and active participation in bridge calls. Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential for coordinating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely resolution and system stability. Job Description Provide L1 and L2 support for critical business applications, ensuring high availability and rapid incident resolution. Monitor application and infrastructure health using tools like Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, and Spotfire. Handle bridge calls during major incidents, ensuring effective communication and coordination across teams. Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for permanent fixes. Execute and monitor batch jobs, cron jobs, and scheduled tasks; ensure timely completion and issue resolution. Develop and maintain shell scripts and automation tools to streamline support operations. Participate in release and change management activities, including pre- and post-deployment validations. Work with DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in cloud environments (AWS/Azure). Follow ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management using tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Document support procedures, RCA reports, and knowledge base articles for operational efficiency. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing timely updates, impact assessments, and resolution plans Required Knowledge And Experiences 2-3 years of experience in Application Support, preferably in a 24x7 environment. Strong hands-on expertise in Linux/Unix systems, including shell scripting and system troubleshooting. Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and issue investigation. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and supporting distributed applications. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. Prior experience in automation of support tasks using scripting languages (Shell, Python). Exposure to ITSM tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Experience in handling bridge calls and coordinating with multiple teams during high-priority incidents. Solid understanding of ITIL processes and certified in ITIL or other relevant frameworks. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration across teams and vendors. Experience with Ab Initio, cron jobs, and batch processing is a plus. Apply SRE principles to improve reliability, scalability, and performance of supported applications through proactive monitoring and automation. Focus on reducing toil by automating repetitive tasks and improving operational efficiency. Participate in blameless postmortems and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives based on incident learnings. Drive observability enhancements by integrating metrics, logs, and traces into monitoring dashboards. Collaborate with engineering teams to define and measure SLIs/SLOs, ensuring alignment with business availability goals. TransUnion Overview: At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. Be a part of our Workforce for Good – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology. TransUnion Job Title Analyst, Applications Support

description: Program Analyst Job #: req39458 Organization: World Bank Sector: General Services Grade: GE Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP) Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment Location: Chennai,India Required Language(s): English Preferred Language(s): Closing Date: 12/3/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC Description At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. title: Data Analyst – Databricks & Power BI
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. You will harness your expertise in data analysis, business fundamentals, statistics, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into meaningful visualizations and compelling stories that influence real-world outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work with vast and complex datasets, helping customers better understand their environments through data-driven insights. By identifying trends, patterns, and opportunities within the data, you will enable smarter decision-making and support business transformation initiatives across the organization. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help organizations turn data into one of their most valuable assets. Develop insightful reports, dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven recommendations for business stakeholders. Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, project requirements, and success criteria. Translate complex business problems into analytical approaches and actionable solutions. Leverage statistical methods, business intelligence tools, and analytical techniques to generate meaningful insights. Communicate findings effectively through storytelling, presentations, and visualizations that influence business decisions. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying data quality issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization. Partner with technical and business teams to ensure data is properly prepared and aligned with organizational goals. Drive data-informed decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable analysis. You will work with talented professionals and collaborate on innovative projects that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with business leaders, customers, data professionals, and technology teams to solve complex challenges through data. Whether you aspire to become a Data Scientist, Business Intelligence Specialist, Analytics Consultant, Data Engineer, or Data Architect, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to help accelerate your career growth. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Strong experience with Databricks, including Delta Live Tables (DLT), Databricks SQL, and Python. Working knowledge of Power BI data modelling, including relationships, measures, DAX, and Power Query. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, data transformation, and query optimization. Experience validating and troubleshooting data feeds, identifying data quality issues, and implementing corrective actions. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management. Experience handling multiple file formats, including CSV, TXT, Excel, JSON, and other structured data sources. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience developing and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting solutions. Experience contributing to Silver and Gold layer modelling within Databricks or modern Lakehouse architectures. Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices. Experience using Python for data transformation, automation, and data quality validation. Working knowledge of Azure Data Platform services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Synapse Analytics. Experience supporting financial, operational, sales, or customer analytics reporting environments. Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, data dictionaries, business rules, and process documentation.
